purpose: Locate whether the homogeneous accepted C2a origin admits any nonzero prescribed top infiltration at the ordinary 0.001-day window, before constructing a full multi-window forcing ramp.

fixed_conditions.origin: After accepted C2a publication at t=0.001 day; all 50 revisions and interface ledger counts equal one.
fixed_conditions.participants: All 50, independently and discarded; no full-service publication is implied.

gates.fresh_process_replay: Two fresh processes must produce byte-identical result JSON.

interpretation_limit: Any observed nonzero-rate pass is only an isolated participant response. It does not qualify multi-column service execution, complete-domain closure or a ramp to 0.1 cm/day. Rates below the listed range are not extrapolated.
